title: Source ownership
responsibility: Shows owned paths, symbols, execution targets and actual archived code at the selected revision.

inputs.name: EntitySource.entity
inputs.description: Entity at the selected revision, including its owned files, symbols, runtime targets and source metadata.

inputs.name: EntitySource.nav
inputs.description: Enclosing screen navigation with the revision-scoped source modal callback.

outputs.name: EntitySource
outputs.description: Owned files, symbols and execution targets, plus a View code button opening the screen modal. No source file is fetched or rendered inline.
